image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a mud turtle resting on a mossy or algae-covered rock near water. The turtle's head is extended, showing a pointed snout and lateral eye. The carapace is dark, high-domed, and appears smooth with visible scute seams. One forelimb is visible, appearing stout and dark with textured skin. The plastron edge is visible, showing a lighter, yellowish-orange hue.
